what: Lower third: an accent bar grows, name and role panels wipe out from behind it, a progress line fills while it holds, then it wipes back
title: Name Surname
intent: Say who is speaking without covering them or stealing the shot
action: The accent bar is already growing on frame 0; the name panel wipes out from behind it with the name rising in its mask, the role panel follows a beat later; while it holds a light runs down the bar and a progress line fills; everything wipes back into the bar
look: Clean broadcast: white and ink panels, one signal-yellow accent, over a footage placeholder
make_it_yours: Set the name (`--title`) and `ROLE`. `BACKDROP = false` gives a flat background; for real footage see `references/produce/overlays-alpha.md`.
craft_note: Lower thirds live on the bottom of the safe area and get an ambient budget while they hold (a light on the bar, a progress line), never accents that pull the eye from the speaker. Check them against the platform's interface (`references/edit/formats-platforms.md`).
